title: Verify: Store focus is null when nothing focused and apply is a no-op
summary: Unit tests for null focus and non-blurring apply
description: Add bootSceneKeyboardStoreNull.test.ts with the same mocks; set the fake object isFocused false and true in separate cases.
acceptance_criteria: With no focused object, Tab leaves store focusedObjectId null and emits focusChange id null.
With a focused object and non-null game state, Tab does not call blur on the object.
technical_constraints: Seed state with createInitialState as in bootSceneFocusApply.test.ts

steps.symbol: new: BootScene keyboard store null and apply
steps.action: Reuse mocks from tests/bootSceneKeyboard.test.ts; add blur: vi.fn() and focus: vi.fn() to the fake object. Test 1: fake.isFocused=false, press('Tab'), expect store focusedObjectId toBeNull and emit calledWith('focusChange',{id:null}). Test 2: seed useGameStore state with createInitialState(worldFixture, sceneSpecFixture) as in bootSceneFocusApply.test.ts, fake.isFocused=true, press('Tab'), expect fake.blur not called.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneKeyboardStoreNull.test.ts
